title: 2018 Dakar Rally
who: Won by Carlos Sainz / Lucas Cruz (Team Peugeot Total) and Matthias Walkner (Red Bull KTM Factory Racing)
summary: The 2018 edition of the Dakar Rally, in its South America era: 11 stage towns and bivouacs through Peru, Bolivia, Argentina. Winners — Cars: Carlos Sainz / Lucas Cruz (Team Peugeot Total); Bikes: Matthias Walkner (Red Bull KTM Factory Racing); Quads: Ignacio Casale (Casale Racing); Trucks: / Evgeny Yakovlev / Vladimir Rybakov (Kamaz-Master); UTVs: Reinaldo Varela / Gustavo Gugelmin (South Racing-Can Am).
approximate: Stage towns and bivouacs from Wikipedia's stage table. The rally ran off-road between them, so the lines are straight from bivouac to bivouac.
